lead: Two grids. `Row` / `Col` is a 24-column grid (as in Ant Design): a row is split into 24 parts, a Col takes `span` of them, and has `offset`, `order` and responsive props that change with the screen width. Use it for page layout. `Grid` is a two-dimensional CSS grid with a fixed column count or columns that fit a minimum width, suited to card walls. All gaps come from the theme style's spacing scale.

gutter.title: Gutter
gutter.description: Gaps come from the theme style's scale; give a pair to set the horizontal and vertical gaps separately. Columns beyond 24 parts wrap to the next line.

responsive.title: Responsive
responsive.description: Resize the browser window: on narrow screens each column fills a row, from 768px two per row, from 992px four per row.

auto-grid.title: Auto-fit grid
auto-grid.description: Columns fit a minimum width: narrow the browser window and the column count drops by itself, no breakpoints needed.

api.title: API Reference
api.note: Every component has `as` to render a different semantic element.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles define the spacing scale in `grid.css`; the responsive breakpoints are one set shared by the whole library (`BREAKPOINTS` in contract.ts).
styling.col: `data-span` / `data-offset` / `data-order`, plus `data-sm-span` and the like for each breakpoint; the values go into the `--_span` / `--_offset` / `--_order` variables
